name: Duskwood worgen
shortDescription: The wolf-men called worgen in the original Ashenvale and Duskwood quest testimony.
body: Interpretive group art based on the Classic-area creature reference. It does not assign every worgen in Duskwood to Velinde’s packs or assert one cause for all local conditions. See docs/research/scythe-of-elune-original-mystery-research.md and docs/research/scythe-of-elune-visual-assets.json.
